findings.reason: A coordinate square materially clarifies the cycle-to-functional-to-coordinate construction and the easy-to-confuse row/column indexing of Pi. The original standalone tiles contain no such illustration. A commutative coordinate square is more precise here than a genus-g surface sketch and directly explains the lattice formula without adding geometric assumptions.
findings.action: Added a final Remarks section with a tikzcd square and explicit normalized generator coordinates, transpose convention, intersection signs and genus-zero convention.

correction: Appended only an explanatory Remarks section. The period map square uses kappa:H_1(X;Z)->Z^g direct-sum Z^g, e:H_1(X;Z)->Omega(X)^*, the dual coordinate isomorphism c, and (m,n)->m+Pi^T n. All original bytes remain an exact prefix.

diagram_math_checks.evidence: Statement (4) and def-period-pairing-and-period-lattice Definition give e with domain H_1(X;Z) and codomain Omega(X)^*. F1 and the symplectic-basis supplier Statement (1) make kappa an abelian-group isomorphism to Z^g direct-sum Z^g. Statement (1)/proof 3.1 give the normalized basis, so evaluation at its g elements makes c a complex-linear isomorphism Omega(X)^* -> C^g.

By the carrier normalized identity P(a_i,omega_j)=delta_ij and Pi_ij=P(b_i,omega_j), c(e(sum_i m_i a_i+n_i b_i)) has jth entry m_j+sum_i n_i Pi_ij. This equals m+Pi^T n and exactly matches both routes in the square; it is the formula already proved in step 6.1. The a_i images are standard columns and the b_i images are transposes of rows i of Pi.
Proof 4.1 establishes Pi=Pi^T, hence the bottom image is Z^g+Pi Z^g as asserted in Statement (4)/step 6.1. The square does not assert a complex-linear structure on the integral homology group.

The symplectic-basis supplier Statement (2) gives <a_i,b_j>=delta_ij and <b_i,a_j>=-delta_ij, agreeing with the Remarks. No curve orientation or intersection is invented in the diagram. For g=0 all four objects and maps are zero, matching carrier proof 1.1.
The original six proof steps are unchanged byte-for-byte; the figure appears after Source notes and is not invoked by any proof step.
